notes.title: Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
Hello Explorers!
We have switched to UE5! We made the decision to switch engines last week after a lot of consideration and research. 
If you'd like to see the full blog post on this announcement, you can view that here: https://socksandgoats.com/blog/unreal-engine-5

Also, you might be missing out on more updates!
We also send out our updates through email usually first. If you'd like to get updates on Project Canopy and see our Roadmap and more, you can sign up here: https://socksandgoats.com/project-canopy

notes.title: Survival Foundations Update
notes.content:
What to look out for in this update?

- This wouldn’t be a survival update without survival stats, right? Oxygen, Hunger, Thirst, and Health have all been added to the game using our new framework.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/466f584aaa8b9817e0e9aed62b1e4a6e32cbee60.png
- Take the HoverBike for a spin to zip through the jungle faster than ever before.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/5e64a3d2ddd5025b2aeb215e4b0521b6d7e499e1.png
- Look for the new massive creature roaming the vegetation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/b0c3eca828b1d1aaef91d4a064aa4c94a2c586dd.png
- New Starter Pod where you can replenish your oxygen, store and retrieve items from your personal container and a Fabricator to craft items hangs on the wall.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/5e64a3d2ddd5025b2aeb215e4b0521b6d7e499e1.png
- Crashed Ships can be found around the map and usually have loot inside them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37731043/d63c87f9a29b5a08087bfa3436793bfc0cd5c66b.png
- Some performance tweaks have been made so vegetation can be seen further.

notes.title: Demo and Big Announcement from the Developer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=fQ2SiVwBfQQ;full][/previewyoutube]
What you can expect:
- Big Announcement!
- New creature reveal
- Play the demo
- Q&A with the Developer
- Exclusive rewards live in-chat

We are going to be showing off the demo and going over a lot of new features and some big announcements! We will be revealing a new creature in development for Project Canopy as well and giving some details on what the next few months will look like for development.
